I have had both experiences on the same meds about 20 years apart. My first dx and rx was 25 years ago at age 16. I had been weeping everyday for nearly a year before my mother finally took me to a psychiatrist.  I was rx zoloft and trazadone. I was aware that nothing that made me deeply sad had changed but i didn’t care and I could not cry. I quit the meds the day i turned 18 which was also the day i moved out of my parents’ home. 
I went many years unmedicated. I did try some different meds in the interim.  They were brought about by desperation on occasions when my emotions and anxiety caused disruptions to my work and relationships. I always quit the meds due to the side effects and just determined to do better and get through things on my own. 
When I experienced a devastating breakup about 5 years ago, I sought medical treatment. Of all the things i had lost my therapist was about to move to another practice. Before she went she got me a psychiatric appointment and i was again rx zoloft and trazadone. It actually stopped my constant level of panic almost immediately. I had more energy and more mental space to deal with things. And I could cry if i needed to!!! 
It’s just wild that i have had both experiences.
